description: Fetch a Destatis GENESIS statistical table's data by its code (get codes from destatis_search), e.g. "12411-0001" (population) or "61111-0001" (consumer price index). Returns the table content (values across its dimensions) plus title. Germany-wide and by Land where the table provides it.

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own free Destatis GENESIS API token. Omit to use the shared Pipeworx token.

name: destatis_table
title: Destatis Table
